page.aboutIntro: What FitPose is, what informs it, and where it's headed next.
page.whatIsText: FitPose is an AI movement coach that watches your form through your own camera and turns real-time posture cues into simple, spoken and visual feedback — built to make consistent movement feel achievable, not clinical.
page.whyPhysioText: Small, correctable movement patterns — a rounded lower back, an uneven squat, tight hips from sitting — compound over time. Guided, consistent movement work is one of the most accessible ways to build and protect long-term mobility.
page.researchFoundationText: FitPose's pose-detection and feedback logic draws on established areas of study: biomechanics and movement quality, computer-vision pose estimation, safety-first feedback prioritization, and behavior design for habit formation.
page.whereHeadedText: Planned enhancements include exercise-specific explainers, condition-aware recovery plans built with licensed physiotherapists, deeper multilingual voice coaching, and clearer long-term progress analytics.
page.scopeText: FitPose provides fitness and movement guidance. It is not a medical diagnostic tool and does not replace assessment by a qualified healthcare professional or physiotherapist where one is needed.
page.faqIntro: Everything people usually ask before their first FitPose session.
faq.q1: Is FitPose a substitute for a physiotherapist?
faq.a1: No. FitPose gives fitness and movement guidance, not a diagnosis. For pain, injury or a medical condition, please see a qualified healthcare professional.
faq.q2: How does the AI know if my form is correct?
faq.a2: Your camera's video is analyzed on-device with pose detection that tracks your joints in real time and compares your movement to the pattern expected for that exercise.
faq.q3: Does FitPose store or share my camera footage?
faq.a3: Pose analysis runs locally in your session; FitPose is built around clear, privacy-first controls rather than uploading raw video.
faq.a4: The FitPose interface is in English. The Voice Assistant and AI Coach can speak English, Hindi, German, Russian, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi and Urdu — pick yours from the profile page.
faq.a5: No — every exercise in the library is bodyweight-only. You just need enough space to see your full body in the camera frame.
faq.q6: Can I change my weekly schedule?
faq.a6: Yes. Visit the Schedule page any time to swap a day's suggested exercise or regenerate the whole week from your AI Coach.
